scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n backend,client -c blue,green "npm:dev:backend" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w client
